description: A divider for METRO's stream of twelve pulses a beat: it passes the stream and the start pulse on, and gives one pulse out of every so many

params.text: Sets how many incoming pulses are counted between output pulses, 1 to 48; with twelve pulses to the beat, 3 gives a quarter of a beat and 12 a whole one
The lamp that flashes each time a division completes; pressing it does nothing

inputs.text: The stream of twelve pulses a beat that is counted
The start and reset pulses from METRO; a rise here also sets the count so that the next pulse counted is the first of a division
A voltage here takes over from the DIV. knob, 0V to 10V across 1 to 48 pulses

outputs.text: Copies the stream of pulses arriving at the twelve-pulse input
Copies the voltage arriving at the start and reset input
A 10V pulse each time the number of pulses set by DIV. has been counted

notes: there is no clock in this module: nothing comes out of the division output until a stream of pulses arrives at the x 12 input, from METRO or another clock

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
